notes.title: A brand new game has been released!
notes.content:
The game is based on the classic novel Journey to the West and constructs a wonderful fantasy world of Journey to the West.
Sun Xiao'ai, a modern girl who yearns for adventure, crossed into the body of Sun Xiaokong in the fantasy world of Journey to the West by chance.
Along the way, he subdued demons and demons, subdued teammates with different personalities such as Zhu Xiaojie, Sha Xiaojing, Xiao Bailong, and Xiao Longnu, and went to the West to explore ways to return to the real world.
This journey has gone through various wonderful adventures, and a huge conspiracy has gradually surfaced. Welcome to the magical fantasy world of Journey to the West!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2860190/_/

notes.title: Alubi Studio's brand new game is about to be released!
notes.content:
艾露比工作室的最新游戏《三国吞天传 幻想姬武神战记》已经登录Steam了！
游戏暂定于2023年5月3日发布，欢迎大家提前将游戏加入愿望单！
游戏根据经典三国剧情改编，加入幻想设定，相信会给你带来耳目一新的游戏体验！
游戏具体的特色请移步本游戏Steam商店页面，或登录B站，观看宣传片以及游戏介绍！
游戏首发还会有折扣优惠，请大家多多支持，谢谢！

notes.title: Updated on September 27, 2022
notes.content:
1. Repair the bug that the root of the world tree Alisa did not enhance the 5000 effect. Thanks for the message reminder from the enthusiasts.

2. The maximum number of items carried has been increased from 20 to 40.

3. If you play in the strong opening and hanging mode, you cannot enter the house in the wall crossing state. You can enter the house by temporarily turning off the wall crossing function.

notes.title: Updated on September 16, 2022
notes.content:
1. The root of the world tree Alisa increased the maximum life from 1000 points to 5000 points.

2. In the open hanging mode, add powerful open hanging props, and use them to obtain the effect of [Invincible Team, Penetrating Walls, and 500 skill points for all members].

3. At the beginning of the game, the road leading to Alubi Studio was opened at the top right of Chentang Pass.

notes.title: 2022/07/11更新
notes.content:
1.修改多处错别字
2.修改几处人物卡住引发的BUG
3.妙妙宝珠改为50000两一次，每次给角色全属性各+10点
4.六魂幡内的小怪敌人将不纳入怪物图鉴
5.艾露比工作室取消进入的限制，随时都可以进入
6.地狱、天界初期敌人能力降低，部分地图遇敌率降低
7.游戏开始可以选择正常游戏或者开挂游戏，选择开挂游戏将获得无限金钱
8.修复某些地点NPC堵门的问题
9.修复云存档
